jobs.title: Practice Operations Manager II
jobs.why: Excellent direct healthcare-operations match covering clinical-practice workflows, patient access, KPI dashboards, process improvement, project implementation, staff leadership, change management, cross-functional coordination, and data analysis.
jobs.gap: The role expects at least 4 years of related experience and healthcare delivery-system depth. Emphasize ABA/healthcare operations, staff training, workflow redesign, reporting, intake/access processes, and systems projects without overstating revenue-cycle expertise.

jobs.title: Practice Operations Manager II
jobs.why: Very strong healthcare practice-operations role with workflow evaluation, staff training, operational projects, dashboards, root-cause analysis, scheduling, patient access, and direct people management. Strong overlap with healthcare operations and training work.
jobs.gap: This opening prefers physician-practice, billing/revenue-cycle, EMR, and supervisory experience. Lead with healthcare operations, training, scheduling/workflow ownership, metrics, and project management while keeping Epic and billing depth precise.

jobs.title: Regional Operations Director - Long Island & NYC
jobs.location: Syosset, NY / Long Island & NYC · Multi-site travel
jobs.why: Outstanding pediatric-healthcare operations target involving multi-site operations, clinical and business KPIs, workflow improvement, staffing, growth strategy, and operational leadership across Long Island and NYC.
jobs.gap: This is a stretch because it calls for 5+ years of healthcare management, multi-site leadership, roughly 100 team members, and substantial P&L ownership. Emphasize healthcare operations, staffing/training, process improvement, cross-functional leadership, and local market knowledge without inflating scale managed.

jobs.title: Clinical Speciality Programs & Operations Manager - NY
jobs.why: Strong healthcare operations match centered on building scalable clinical workflows, SOPs, referral and intake pathways, KPI tracking, operational playbooks, care-delivery infrastructure, and cross-functional work across clinical, technology, finance, and growth teams.
jobs.gap: Atria seeks 5+ years plus stronger P&L, healthcare analytics, EHR, and Lean/Six Sigma depth. Position workflow design, intake, operations, training, reporting, and healthcare systems work accurately and treat finance/Lean depth as the main gap.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Strong healthcare-tech implementation fit involving end-to-end project delivery, workflow optimization, configuration, data migration, client training, documentation, stakeholder alignment, troubleshooting, and clinical/IT coordination.
jobs.gap: The role prefers 5+ years and hands-on EHR implementation/configuration experience. API integrations and SQL-based reporting are pluses; keep SQL at foundational/working knowledge and emphasize transferable implementation, workflow, training, and systems-troubleshooting experience.

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Excellent healthcare implementation and training alignment: project plans, workstreams, client deployments, dashboards, documentation, training materials, stakeholder communication, post-launch support, and healthcare workforce technology.
jobs.gap: Senior-level implementation ownership and required Smartsheet proficiency are the biggest risks. Emphasize Monday.com, Microsoft tools, training, reporting, workflow implementation, healthcare operations, and transferable project-management experience.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Good digital-health implementation match owning enterprise launches from kickoff through go-live and coordinating cross-functional workstreams across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Care. Strong overlap with onboarding, implementation, healthcare workflows, and operational execution.
jobs.gap: The posting seeks roughly 5–10 years of experience and enterprise-client implementation depth. Emphasize healthcare operations, onboarding, project coordination, process design, training, and cross-functional delivery while being precise about enterprise scale.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.why: Strong healthcare growth-operations option centered on CRM health, funnel workflows, reporting, attribution, martech integrations, process optimization, and AI-assisted marketing operations rather than SEO ownership.
jobs.gap: The role asks for deep HubSpot expertise and 5+ years of marketing-operations experience. Lead with marketing background, workflow automation, analytics, CRM/process thinking, reporting, and systems work without claiming HubSpot depth not held.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.why: Solid healthcare business-operations fit within a large ambulatory and specialty-care organization. The role aligns with operational improvement, cross-functional execution, practice support, and healthcare systems/process work.
jobs.gap: The available posting is less detailed than the top-ranked roles, and SCA may favor deeper ambulatory-surgery or physician-practice operations experience. Use the healthcare-operations resume and verify role scope before applying.

jobs.title: Research Program Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare program-management option involving portfolio oversight, timelines, documentation, staff leadership, budgets, reporting, operational coordination, and cross-functional execution within a major health system.
jobs.gap: This role is research-heavy and prefers 5+ years plus NIH-funded research/project leadership. It is a stretch versus the core healthcare-operations track, so apply only if the research-program environment is appealing and emphasize transferable program/operations management rather than claiming research expertise.
